dish.title: White Bean Kale Soup
dish.name: White Bean Kale Soup
dish.description: White bean and kale soup with fennel, garlic, tomato, and enough salt for a pot of broth.

recipe.provenance_note: Legacy menu text of unknown origin. This draft reconciles that text. It does not claim a kitchen test.

recipe_version.title: White Bean Kale Soup
recipe_version.description: White bean and kale soup with fennel, garlic, tomato, and enough salt for a pot of broth.
recipe_version.serving_basis_note: Quantities are for 4 servings. One- and two-serving floors are not in this draft.
recipe_version.doneness: Fennel soft, kale tender, beans hot through.

ingredients.name: vegetable broth
ingredients.note: Check the carton. Wheat or soy on the label would be an allergen this package does not claim.

ingredients.name: Diamond Crystal kosher salt
ingredients.note: Stirred in at the end. If the broth is already salty, start with 2 g. 4 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt (1.5 tsp). The same weight is 0.75 tsp Morton coarse kosher salt or 0.75 tsp table salt. UC ANR publication 390575 (November 2023): Diamond Crystal kosher salt 2.8 g per teaspoon, Morton coarse kosher salt 4.8 g per teaspoon, table salt 6 g per teaspoon.

steps.title: Saute the fennel
steps.body: Cook the fennel in the neutral oil over medium heat for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and cook 1 minute.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.body: Add the cannellini beans, vegetable broth, and diced tomatoes. Simmer 20 minutes.

steps.title: Wilt the kale and season
steps.body: Stir in the kale and cook about 5 minutes, until tender. Stir in the Diamond Crystal kosher salt and the black pepper. Taste a spoonful and stop if the broth was already salty enough. Cheese, sausage, and cream are not in this soup because the package is dairy-free and plant-based, and those foods would add allergens it does not claim.

recipe_version.dietary_label_note: Plant and dairy-free. No cheese, cream, sausage, or bread. Not a gluten-free claim, because the broth carton was not checked.
allergen_notes: No egg, milk, soy, wheat, sesame, peanut, tree_nut, shellfish, or finfish in the named foods.
Empty means those tokens are not in the named ingredients. It does not mean a flavored broth was checked. If the carton lists wheat or soy, add that token.
v1 also had an empty allergen array. The empty array is kept on purpose.

dietary_eligibility.hh001_reason: Plant ingredients. No dairy, meat, poultry, finfish, shellfish, or nuts. Broth label was not checked. Not kitchen-tested.

changes_from_v1: Equipment listed a sheet pan and the spark was sheet. No step uses a sheet pan. v2 equipment is a pot. Spark sheet is not carried.
Chip said 35 min. Metadata said prep 15 plus cook 25 equals 40. Steps are 5 plus 20 plus an untimed kale wilt. v2 cook is 30 and total is 45.
Season had no salt or pepper. v2 adds 1/2 tsp kosher salt and 1/4 tsp black pepper, drafter amounts.
Can sizes were unnamed. v2 uses 15 oz beans and a 14.5 oz can of diced tomatoes.
Beans are drained and rinsed. v1 did not say. That keeps the 6 cups of broth as the liquid.
Tomatoes were in the simmer sentence and missing from ingredient_refs. v2 refs include them.
Doneness was null. v2 records softened fennel, a 20-minute simmer, and tender kale.
